measured_but_excluded.note: MEASURED observations excluded by the trading-day axis rule -- an EXCLUSION, never an absence. The measurements persist at silver fact_holdings (and gold value_dates, surfaced off-axis if any); nothing is fabricated, nothing destroyed. Five of these (2026-06-13/14/19/20/21) were previously SERVED via the retired global-axis import. A calendar-day custody series is a legitimate NEW artifact with its own contract if ever needed -- never a widening of this one (ruling, forward door).

padding_never_measured.note: pre-restructure axis rows dropped as PADDING (transition record, fixed list): the retired global-axis import carried these non-trading dates with NO measurement on any leg -- their absence from this artifact must never be read as an observed $0

axis_rule.rule: canonical NYSE trading days, SERVED_AS_OF_FIRST .. the slice's own measured frontier. Non-trading dates NEVER enter this axis (CONVERGED RULING (b)+(b+) 20260803T215349Z): the global axis is a UNION of feeder axes (T2.A, dim :1779), so a calendar day admitted here would propagate into the served Opal aggregate trend

cottonwood.note: structurally absent before first coverage -- NOT an exception (the fold discriminator)

channel_participation.default: contributed on every in-coverage axis date
channel_participation.law: Participation of THIS firm's model leg on its own composed axis. NOTHING IS CARRIED on a per-firm surface -- the carry exists only in the global fold; last_carried_as_of here denotes the last MEASURED as-of (v1.1 name reused, one-vocabulary condition). Sanctioned interpolated-backfill dates are NOT exceptions (basis lives in cohort_provenance -- the two-vocabularies law). Consumers requiring fully-contributed data MUST check exceptions for the date; the first past_window row is the honest-dark-vs-broken transition marker.

composed_backfill.authority: Andrew-direct 2026-07-28 (CTO relays 235944Z + 0004Z rider): the labeled interpolated backfill is SANCTIONED for cottonwood's pre-measured history only; interpolation stays forbidden where measured data exists
composed_backfill.law: splice strictly < first_measured_date; labels preserved verbatim (interpolated_estimate), never relabeled; counts never backfilled; measured-vs-backfill collision refuses the build

meta.count_axis_note: account_count is per-model and fans out +1 per underlying model on a blend; summing it across models double-counts (447 vs 296 on 2026-07-22). Never total this column.

custom_residual_detail.note: Per-NORMALISED-name breakdown of every dollar excluded from by_model + model_aua -- both declared residuals (INCOME_NON_MODEL_NAMES) and auto-classified Custom models (is_auto_custom -- Andrew-direct 2026-09-21 ~17:58Z, any new name that says 'Opal'). 'auto_classified': true marks the latter; false is a declared residual. Additive field -- income_non_model_residual's aggregate is unchanged in shape, this is the detail it never carried. The name is NORMALISED (whitespace-collapsed) for grouping only, never a served key (is_auto_custom's own contract).

income_non_model_residual.note: Opal - Income routes NON-MODEL (standing G8 ruling, harmonized at this slice); excluded from by_model + model_aua; reported, never vanished. non_model_aua stays honest-None (the FULL non-model quantity is still unmeasured from the Rebalancer). AS OF 2026-09-21 (Andrew-direct ~17:58Z, /open-calls call 1): this total ALSO carries any newly-discovered Opal-named model auto-classified Custom (see custom_residual_detail below for the per-name breakdown) -- the field name predates that widening and is kept for backward compatibility, not because every dollar in it is Income-specific.

meta.non_model_aua_status: BALANCE = partner_custody_total - model_aua, derived where BOTH present (PRD three-quantity convention); honest-None where either leg is absent -- never independently sourced, never fabricated

opal_sma_sleeves.note: Sleeves the shared name rule (rebalancer_schemas.opal_sma_member_of) reads as Opal SMAs: by_model cohort_class 'sma' keyed by registry member_id, EXCLUDED from model_aua (their dollars stay inside non_model; the category tree carves them out of Client). Not folded into Global (Andrew-direct 2026-10-01 ~20:3xZ/~20:4xZ).

registered_custom_models.note: Opal-named non-primary models with their own by_model key, INSIDE model_aua, placed under Models > Custom by the registry (Andrew-direct 2026-10-01 ~20:3xZ). custom_residual_detail now carries only Opal-named models with no CUSTOM_KEY row.

source_vintage.declared_cadence: D+2 with roster per_partner_max_lag carry window = 3 trading days (CTO 230319Z/233402Z) -- tdb <= 3 is WITHIN DECLARED CADENCE, not staleness; never read this field as a verdict without the cadence beside it
source_vintage.frontier_basis: t-1-settled-close (T2.B ruling @440d16e018 term (2); the T2.C clock DOC carrying the timing values is under v2 re-declaration -- this basis cites the RULING, not a clock value, and survives the re-declaration)

meta.total_source: SUM('Market Value') over blackdiamond/cottonwood/silver/fact_holdings per date -- MEASURED daily holdings snapshot, never interpolated (PRD @e1d525341 sec-3; same derivation as DDB cohort cottonwood_bd_holdings)

value_date_rekey.authority: CTO three conditions 234639Z; pulled forward Andrew-direct ~0337Z 2026-07-29
value_date_rekey.keyed_by: value_date -- each gold partition keyed at its OWN value_date column (G7 Finding-A re-key; partition key = assignment date is provenance, never the value axis)

source_vintage_last.semantics: TO-5 (b) REVAMP-SILVER honest provenance (Andrew/CTO 161549Z): overall = oldest per-firm as_of across the REVAMP's OWN consumed AUA-bearing sources (model_aua = smartx aum_daily [49F] / eclipse fact_portfolios_full [inflection]; partner_custody = schwab fact_rps_s2 [49F] / orion fact_assets [inflection]) -- the artifact's REAL data lineage, NOT the legacy feeders (mirroring them would be false provenance). as_of per source = the last axis date it carries real data. status is TRADING-DAY-AWARE (NEVER#1, CTO 162838Z): trading_days_behind counts NYSE trading days to the settled frontier -- T-1 (tdb<=1) is HEALTHY='current' (an AUM pipeline is T-1 by default; a healthy T-1 read must NOT false-alarm on a Monday), BEHIND only at tdb>=2. UNKNOWN when a load-bearing vintage is unverifiable. Wall-clock age is NOT stored here (CTO 031740Z: clock content lives in _provenance, computed from `overall`, never inside a data-as-of field). Provenance/freshness only (not FE-consumed).
